uploads.evidence: Native metadata/checksum, image resize, attachment-only filename FTS, purge and nested/analysis rollback tests pass. Independent image upload/lightbox browser passes; actual 3840x2160 JPEG becomes 1200x675 JPEG. Wider media validation remains pending.

media.evidence: Real JPEG resizing and PNG analysis/thumbnail pass. Uploaded avatar HTTP200/WebP/public cache/304 and trusted default bot SVG pass. websockets.evidence: Independent pre-cutover live sockets reject forged/private streams and stop publication after logout. The default JSON room and Livewire sidebar subscriptions, per-user authorization and payload confidentiality are focused-test verified. PR7's branch-head two-tab sidebar run passed through a local Pusher-compatible relay; managed-Reverb production verification and sustained multi-tab behavior remain pending.

presence.evidence: The active Alpine stream joins the managed-Reverb room presence channel and the obsolete 50-second application presence endpoint/controller path is absent. The final harness records presence subscription frames and a ten-minute zero-application-request idle observation; coordinator live execution remains pending.

push.evidence: Focused Livewire tests verify accepted endpoint persistence, per-user list/remove/test scoping, cross-user rejection and queued DeliverPush dispatch without rendering endpoint or key material. PR8's headed persistent-Chrome matrix live-verifies subscription, real database-queue delivery, notification display, cross-user denial, own removal and logout cleanup. PR8.1 focused security tests verify that the push-service host allowlist is followed by the shared true-global address classifier, a persisted endpoint is re-resolved once at delivery, and that exact classified address is carried into the WebPush client's no-redirect, no-proxy cURL pin. PR8.1 focused payload tests capture the JSON handed to WebPush and verify the service worker contract {title, options: {body, data: {path, badge}}}; producer tests verify the same pre-badge structure, and an exact base-shaped queued payload is normalized to that contract at handling. Focused diagnostic tests verify correlated attempt/outcome records contain only worker host, push-service host, subscription id, payload size/keys, success/expiry, HTTP status and a safe reason category while credential and content sentinels remain absent, including VAPID persistence and WebPush construction exceptions with no raw previous chain. The repaired harness inputs are contract-tested, and an executable nested success/failure artifact test verifies credential replacement plus URL query, fragment and credential-route redaction; production push delivery remains pending live verification.

webhooks.evidence: Independent local HTTP receiver verifies actual queued delivery and persisted native bot reply; PHPUnit verifies no callback loop. PR8 canonicalizes every address through one classifier: IPv4 must first belong to a positive public-unicast class and then survive subtraction of IANA non-global, special, multicast and reserved ranges, while IPv6 must first belong to 2000::/3 and then survive subtraction of documentation, benchmarking, ORCHIDv2, Teredo, 6to4 and the remaining non-global special-purpose ranges. Explicit globally reachable exceptions are preserved. The classifier governs literal saves, validation, DNS answers and the normalized address passed to the cURL connection pin. Permanent reproducer and top-nibble tests verify the allowlist structure; removing the IPv6 membership gate, IPv4 special-range subtraction or normalized classifier output each turns its focused test red. A real Guzzle cURL-handler test proves the pin, redirect refusal and unknown-length 20 MiB ceiling.

unfurl.evidence: Focused PR8.1 security tests verify that the initial client-supplied URL and every redirect hop use the shared true-global address classifier, refuse non-global IPv4 and IPv6 answers before sending, and pin the exact classified address with redirects and proxies disabled. Broader metadata extraction and browser behavior remain pending.

jobs.evidence: Native durable auxiliary worker executes real delivery; PHPUnit checks afterCommit and rollback. PR8's PostgreSQL run uses a separate PHP 8.5 database queue worker and finishes with zero queued or failed jobs.

fresh_setup.evidence: Isolated blank native installation, first administrator and real login verified in independent browser (4 assertions).

backup.evidence: Actual disposable SQLite snapshot passes integrity_check; native jobs, upload files and VAPID keys included. Restore smoke test pending.

The final committed harness now combines native login/logout/419 CSRF, chat/presence/unread/typing/edit/delete/boost, image/video/search, a fixed ten-minute zero-application-request idle observation, and sleep-latency signature with a kept-awake control. The PR9 coordinator live gate has not run.

benchmarks.evidence: Matched production HTTP runs against Ruby and Django: identical ordered windows, successful persisted body-bearing writes, FTS and SQLite integrity. Real resized JPEGs verified. Two paced runs admit all 100 sockets and fully deliver all 30 messages; no capacity limit inferred. Raw outputs remain ignored.
